hypotheses.hypothesis: Comparing the ciphertext to a constant-time generated one creates measurable timing differences depending on the secret token value.
hypotheses.trigger_condition: The memcmp function is used to compare the ciphertext with a constant-time generated one, where the secret token value is used to generate the latter.
hypotheses.test_vector_hint: Sweep the secret token values from 0 to 255 and measure the delta in timing across 10000 runs.
